items.summary: Shipped high-scale frontend features for Dream11’s 250M+ user app, owning product refinements, GraphQL contracts, UI implementation, integrations, releases, and migration work from React Native to Expo.
highlights: Built 8+ end-to-end features with animations, routing, pagination, pull-to-refresh, store, real-time AppSync and socket integrations, and privacy controls impacting 10M+ daily active users
Shipped MGMR with Expo and Tailcall, handling team creation and animated preview flows while supporting peak concurrency of 200k+ user creates
Owned GraphQL and Apollo integrations across the Dream11 app, monographQL, and microfrontend surfaces at roughly 1M+ average RPM, simplifying complex subgraphs
Built custom component libraries with Storybook and a tokens pipeline wired to design output, reducing repetitive styling changes across apps
Improved code quality and team velocity through cleanups, internal dev tools, profiling, and Retool-based no-code workflows for CMS operations
